remarks: THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST - SELLERS WILL REVIEW OFFERS ON TUESDAY 5/19 AT 1200. Perfectly positioned on a quiet cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Saw Mill neighborhood, this unique ranch with a contemporary flair and open floor plan offers a seamless blend of comfort and style. Enjoy picturesque pond views from the expansive deck, rebuilt with Brazilian Ipe wood-ideal for relaxing afternoons-or gather around the stone fire pit for evenings with friends. The main level features a spacious living room with fireplace and a formal dining room, both with French doors opening to the deck. A newer European-style eat-in kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room. The primary suite, along with two generously sized bedrooms and a convenient laundry room, complete this level.  Recently installed Marvin Integra windows and French doors fill the home with natural light while showcasing the surrounding mature trees and landscaped grounds. In 2019, the walk-out lower level was beautifully finished to include a family room, exercise area, game space, bedroom, office, and full bath-offering flexible space for today's lifestyle needs. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the close proximity to The Harry Day Preserve, with 216 acres of scenic hiking trails just a short walk away. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, style, and nature in one exceptional setting. Buyers to do their own due diligence regarding The Saw Mill Association.
